name: v2-undeclared-import
source: Phase 77 rule: model imports a package the repo doesn't depend on
patch:
diff --git a/src/price.ts b/src/price.ts
--- a/src/price.ts
+++ b/src/price.ts
@@ -1 +1 @@
-const sum: string = p.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
+import sumBy from 'lodash/sumBy'
+const sum: number = sumBy(p)
